source: Published MySEQ offset list, showeq.net forum thread '10/21 offsets' (showthread.php?8425), labeled PatchDate=10/21/2026. Same line-wrap space in the pasted ClientHash as the previous two lists ('...ebd9 c'); closed up it matches eqoffsets.buildinfo.client_hash() on the binary exactly. Binary compiled 10/19/2026, published/labeled 10/21 -- filed under the compile date to pair with binaries/2026-10-19/ for crosscheck.

_provenance.method: cli.py resolve --binary binaries/2026-10-19/eqgame.exe --sigs sigs/2026-09-11.json --known known/2026-09-11.json, run cold (no known-offsets for this patch yet), then checked field-by-field against this published list once it arrived.

comparison_2026_10_21.result: 39/40 values matched (3 File Info + 6 globals + 31 struct fields).
comparison_2026_10_21.memory_offsets: all 6 matched exactly, including both SPLIT votes (CharInfo 2/5, TargetAddr 2/3). As at the previous two boundaries, every minority signature failed to fire rather than voting for a different address.
comparison_2026_10_21.struct_offsets: 27 of 31 auto-confirmed and all correct, including two large shifts (OwnerIDOffset 0x54c -> 0x334, HideOffset 0x504 -> 0x238). 4 were left UNCONFIRMED; 3 of those carried-forward values happened to still be right, 1 was not (LevelOffset).

unconfirmed_fields.LevelOffset: 0x270 -> 0x52C (published). THE ONE MISMATCH. Raw votes were 0x52c x4 (LevelOffset#2-#5: three 'root', one 'this'), 0x268 x1 (LevelOffset#6, 'this'), 4 no match. The plurality was correct; the single dissent blocked Resolution.consistent and resolve carried the stale 0x270 forward. The dissenting site is 'lea rcx, [rdi+0x270]' feeding a call -- an address-of on a field every correct site accesses as a byte, and the same function's neighbouring '+0x2f0' moved to '+0x2e8', i.e. a different struct that shares the offset, reached through 'this' propagation.
unconfirmed_fields.NameOffset: 0xb4 (published, unchanged). Votes 0xb4 x8, 0x1f6 x1 (NameOffset#8, 'this', a 'mov byte ptr [rcx+0xb4], dl' store that is not a name access).
unconfirmed_fields.IdOffset: 0x10 (published, unchanged). Votes 0x10 x8, 0x8 x1 -- the same lone dissenter as the 07/17->08/19 boundary.
unconfirmed_fields.YOffset: GroundItem 0x90 (published, unchanged). Votes 0x90 x3, 0x98 x2 (YOffset#1, #7, both 'this'). Notable: none of the 9 YOffset signatures is a float access; several load a qword pointer from +0x90, null-check it and call through it. The value is right because Y did not move, not because these sites are GroundItem.Y.

_provenance.anchor_tier_note: First observed wrong votes from the 'this' tier (LevelOffset#6, GroundItem YOffset#1/#7). Across the previous two boundaries every wrong vote traced to 'linkseed'.
